items.title_en: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.title_cn: Essentials: Nicotine's Effects on the Brain & Body & How to Quit Smoking or Vaping
items.desc_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, I explain how nicotine affects the brain and body, including how it increases dopamine, acetylcholine and norepinephrine to boost motivation, focus and alertness, suppresses appetite and raises heart rate and blood pressure. I distinguish nicotine itself from its delivery methods — smoking, vaping, dipping and snuffing — and explain their serious health risks, why vaping is especially habit-forming and why quitting is so difficult. I also discuss science-based tools to quit smoking or vaping, including clinical hypnosis, prescription medication and nico

items.title_en: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.title_cn: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
items.desc_en:
Paul Stamets is widely regarded as the father of modern applied mycology for his work on fungi and their applications in human health. We discuss how mushrooms and other fungi affect, and can improve, our immune system; how certain non-psychedelic mushrooms can enhance cognition and brain plasticity; and the use of psilocybin for depression, anxiety, and other mental health conditions, as well as important safety considerations. This episode is for anyone seeking to learn more about the biology of fungi and their medicinal and other uses.

Show notes: https://www.hubermanlab.com/episode/mushro

items.title_en: Essentials: How Emotions & Social Factors Impact Learning | Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang
items.title_cn: Essentials: How Emotions & Social Factors Impact Learning | Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang
items.desc_en:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Mary Helen Immordino-Yang, EdD, a professor of education and psychology at the University of Southern California (USC) and director of the USC Center for Affective Neuroscience, Development, Learning and Education (CANDLE). We discuss how emotions, stories and culture shape the way we perceive the world, learn and build a sense of self. We also explain how our narratives can foster empathy or dehumanization, and how education can be redesigned to engage curiosity, meaning-making and the development of the whole person.

items.title_cn: Why Addiction is a Control Problem | Dr. Anna Lembke
items.desc_en:
Dr. Anna Lembke discusses addiction and its correlation to our innate desire to assert control and reduce uncertainty. 

Dr. Anna Lembke is chief of the Addiction Medicine Dual Diagnosis Clinic at Stanford and a leading expert in how to overcome addictions of all kinds.
